promotion.detainInto: Students staying in the class go to

promotion.done: Done: {{promoted}} promoted, {{detained}} in the same class, {{passed}} passed out, {{left}} left.

transfer.title: Transfer & leaving
transfer.subtitle: Transfer certificates: someone asks for one, someone who may approve issues it — then the student is marked as left.

transfer.promotedHint: As it should read on the TC

idCard.rules: This card is the property of the school. Carry it every day. Report a lost card to the office at once.

photo.title: Photo
photo.hint: Used on the ID card. Square, face clearly visible.
photo.wrongType: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP picture.
photo.tooBig: That picture is too large even after shrinking. Try another.

idCards.title: ID cards
idCards.subtitle: Print students’ ID cards — front and back, standard card size — with photo and a QR that anyone can scan to check the card.
idCards.missingPhotos_one: {{count}} student has no photo yet — the card prints their initials. Tap the camera to add one.
idCards.missingPhotos_other: {{count}} students have no photo yet — their cards print initials. Tap the camera to add photos.
idCards.hint: The layout, colour, fields and the text on the back are set in Settings › Students. A reprint keeps the same QR.
